import collections
def state(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    W=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(a) for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='W']
    rowY=collections.Counter(i for i,row in enumerate(a) for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='Y')
    hr=[r for r,n in rowY.items() if n>15]
    colY=collections.Counter(j for i,row in enumerate(a) for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='Y')
    vc=[c for c,n in colY.items() if n>5]
    return W, (hr[0] if hr else None), (vc[0] if vc else None)
r1=action(['DOWN']*3+['LEFT']*2, intent='explore')
print('after yellow moves:', state(current_frame), {k:r1.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','no_impact')})
if not (r1.get('level_completed') or r1.get('done')):
    r2=action(['SPACE'], intent='explore')
    print('after SPACE:', state(current_frame), {k:r2.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done')})
    if not (r2.get('level_completed') or r2.get('done')):
        r3=action(['UP']*7+['RIGHT']*5, intent='explore')
        print('after blue moves:', state(current_frame), {k:r3.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','no_impact')})
bar=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[-1]
print('bar p:',bar.count('p'),'w:',bar.count('w'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
